decoder_stack_lower_bound.interpretation: Per-layer trace timings are a lower bound and exclude the full-model trace scheduler, final norm, vocabulary LM head, canonical sampler, and scalar token-out boundary.

batch_slice_repair.root_cause: The fixed 32-row sampler-feedback token tensor was embedded and executed through all decoder layers even for logical batch 1; inactive rows gated cache updates but not norm, MoE, or MLP compute.
batch_slice_repair.fix: Keep the fixed sampler feedback tensor address, slice hidden/position/page-table views to logical batch before decoder compute, then pad only local logits back to 32 rows at the sampling boundary.
batch_slice_repair.verdict: resolved: full model is now like-for-like logical batch 1 and within 1.31x of the decoder-only lower bound including terminal, sampling, trace orchestration, and scalar output

reduced_device_profile.scope: one sliding layer, one full layer, final norm, sharded LM head, position advance, and canonical Sampling1D force-argmax
reduced_device_profile.note: Four concurrently executing device rows are merged, so the op sum is diagnostic rather than wall time. Sampler argmax is 5.85% of the reduced op sum and does not dominate.
